financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Warrant inducement exercise of existing warrants at reduced price (gross proceeds; net not given)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The gross proceeds from the exercise of the induced warrants was $4.6 million, prior to deducting placement agent fees and offering expenses.

warrants.quote: The New Series H Warrants will have an exercise price of $0.70 per share, will be initially exercisable on the 6 month anniversary of the issuance date and will have a term of 66 months from the issuance date.
The Common Warrants will have an initial exercise price of $2.00 per share or $1.999 per pre-funded warrant
